== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Reliable is a unique sea vessel characterized by its appearance as an animated, floating conch shell that has expanded into the form of a ship. According to [[Guild]] legends, the vessel is unsinkable. The ship was tasked with transporting a significant item to [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] for secure burial following its discovery by [[Loreli]]. However, during its mission, the ship became ensnared by the vegetation of a [[roaming island]], where it was pulled into the treeline and tilted against the land. While the vessel's captain, [[Tommison]], and his crew faced significant peril, three members of the crew survived. Although the ship is capable of being launched without its captain, it cannot be sailed effectively under such circumstances, and the presence of predatory [[Elderspawn]] in the surrounding waters further complicates its use.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Reliable is a [[Navigator’s ship|Navigator ship]] commanded by [[Tommison|Captain Tommison]]. The vessel possesses a unique appearance, resembling an animated, floating conch shell. There are indications that the ship's crew may be located within the tower.}}
